candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition from smartfix_owner == msg.sender to smartfix_owner != msg.sender, so that selfdestruct is only callable by non-owners, changing who can successfully call sudicideAnyone.
Delete the require statement, so that anyone can call selfdestruct, changing the set of callers who can succeed.
Replace selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender)) with a no-op (e.g., a revert or an empty block) so that the contract does not self-destruct, which changes the outcome of a successful call.
